correctness.rationale: From actual RESULT.md and the publisher density f_alpha=P_alpha L/C, the analytic logarithmic derivative is q=-2α(1−αx)/((1−αx)^2+1)+4x(x²−1)/((x²−1)^2+2)−tanh(x/2). For α>0: q(−∞)=+1,q(0)=−α<0,q(2)≥(1−√2)/2+24/11−tanh(1)=1.21311724467587...>0,q(+∞)=−1. Continuity plus non-identically-zero analyticity forces a positive-to-negative crossing on each disjoint interval (−∞,0) and (2,+∞), hence two strict modes. α<0 reduces by reflection f_α(x)=f_{−α}(−x); α=0 is even with q(2)>0, q(+∞)<0, providing mirrored outer modes. This proves at least two modes for ALL real α, not exactly two or at most three. Independent recomputation checked q bound and density normalization.
